area: Bromley-by-Bow on the Lea: a STREET with Berger Hall and Sunday School at the north-west, Bell Road and the lane to Four Mills Bridge, St Leonard's Street by Bromley Lock, Four Mills Distillery and Sun Mills (Corn) on the west bank, the River Lea channel (mud, H.W.M.O.T./L.W.M.O.T.), the hatched east bank with open ground and a works beyond, the School (Boys, Girls & Infants), Spey Street, Bruce Road and the street along the south edge

LEA, Mud, big G; r1c0 School Boys Girls & Infants, P.H.; r1c1 Four Mills Distillery; r1c2 works blocks, H.W.M.O.T.; r2c0 SPEY, BRU.., STREET; r2c1 circular tanks, Mud; r2c2 Mud, tanks, bank hatching); contact sheets cs1-cs6 at 6x +-22 px, cs7 at 8x; region views regA (B.M.34.99 pheon), regB (15.2 by Sun Mills), regC (16.8 box, B.M.18.53), regD (B.M.17.19), regE (B.M.20.00), regF (path to Four Mills Bridge, 2x), regG (16.1 survey station, 10x), regH (east bank and works, 2x); digit strips nn1-nn4 at 7-20x (34.99, 32.4, 25.2, 17.19, 20.00, 18.6, 14.7, 21.6 vs 14.8, 18.2); marker sheets mk1-mk3. legibility: Clean. A thin straight vertical line at px ~830 crosses the river, bank hatching and fields unbroken: probable sheet join (tool silent; no clear tint step). No missing tiles. Figures cut at the north edge (~400,0) and south edge (B.M.18·45 at ~880,1020) and at the west edge (~0,652).
